title: "Model Persistence — k-Means"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Overview

This example demonstrates saving and loading a trained k-means model using `save_model` / `load_model` with the `aoclda` package.

```{r library}
library(aoclda)
```

## Train

```{r train}
set.seed(42)
X <- matrix(rnorm(5000), nrow = 1000, ncol = 5)

km <- kmeans$new(n_clusters = 3, seed = 42)
km$fit(X)

labels_before <- km$predict(X[1:10, , drop = FALSE])
centers_before <- km$cluster_centres

cat(sprintf(
    "Cluster centers shape: %d x %d\n",
    nrow(centers_before), ncol(centers_before)
))
cat(sprintf("First 10 predictions: %s\n", paste(labels_before, collapse = " ")))
```

## Save and Load

```{r persistence}
model_path <- tempfile(fileext = ".rds")
save_model(km, model_path)
rm(km)

print_model_metadata(model_path)

km_loaded <- load_model(model_path)
```

## Predict After Load

```{r after}
labels_after <- km_loaded$predict(X[1:10, , drop = FALSE])
centers_after <- km_loaded$cluster_centres

cat(sprintf("First 10 predictions after load: %s\n", paste(labels_after, collapse = " ")))

labels_match <- identical(as.integer(labels_before), as.integer(labels_after))
centers_match <- isTRUE(all.equal(centers_before, centers_after))

cat(sprintf("\nLabels match: %s\n", labels_match))
cat(sprintf("Centers match: %s\n", centers_match))

file.remove(model_path)
```
